specName: A Generic FBL Implementation for Visual Studio Code
approach: Port standalone's FBL library (25fc7b4a) to TypeScript in src/core/fbl of etalii.adp.ide.vscode, module by module, on bytes, with its 86 tests ported first and FBL as referee where the two differ. No dependency is added: the library has its own bounded regular expression matcher, CEL subset and YAML, JSON, XML and line readers. FBL's corpus and standalone's real files are copied into fixtures/fbl with a checked manifest, and the packaged plug-in exposes the library only through what activate returns, for one in-editor test.

decisions.decision: Port standalone's library module by module, with FBL as referee
decisions.why: SC-004 asks for standalone's splices byte for byte and FBL 6.3 leaves no freedom in new text
decisions.rejected: Writing from the specification alone and comparing afterwards; compiling the C# for Node

decisions.decision: A regular expression matcher of the library's own with a step budget
decisions.why: FBL section 16 requires a bounded match and JavaScript's RegExp cannot be bounded or interrupted on its thread; the loader must parse the subset anyway
decisions.rejected: Unbounded RegExp; a worker thread with a timeout; re2 or re2js as a new bundled dependency

decisions.decision: Port standalone's CEL subset, corrected to CEL where standalone strays
decisions.why: Five baseline tests fix which expressions compile; FBL names CEL as the definition
decisions.rejected: A CEL package from npm; copying standalone's deviations

decisions.decision: Expose the library only as AdpApi.fbl, the object activate returns
decisions.why: It must be reachable from the entry point to be in the bundle, and FR-004 rules out a tool, editor, command or setting

decisions.decision: Copy the real files standalone's tests read, under the same paths, about 3 MB
decisions.why: All 14 real-file tests on bodies and registrations then have counterparts and only the module cross-check does not apply
decisions.rejected: One file per declared binding; leaving out the 2.6 MB of Turtle

decisions.decision: Build only what the fixtures and the 86 baseline tests prove; list the rest as not implemented and report it
decisions.why: A behaviour no fixture pins down would have two hosts decide bytes separately, against FR-014
decisions.rejected: Implementing every FBL sentence standalone leaves out

plan.summary: Plan, research (R1 to R18, Q1 to Q7), data model, three contracts and quickstart for a TypeScript port of standalone's FBL library into etalii.adp.ide.vscode, with no new dependency and one test of 86 not applicable

tasks.summary: 74 tasks in 7 phases: setup 11, foundational reading 21, US1 16, US2 12, US3 5, US4 5, polish and delivery 4; tests first in every phase; code in etalii.adp.ide.vscode, one pull request

concerns.note: D1 CRITICAL: FR-013 limits (regex step budget and fbl.regex-timeout in T020, maxBodyBytes and maxEntries in T032, CEL budget in T021) are built with no test task; no baseline test covers them, so FR-023 and principle IV of the VS Code repository are not met

F1 HIGH: T060 and the Phase 4 independent test expect baseline.test.ts to pass, but it needs the 14 real-file titles whose files are only written in Phase 5 (T063, T064); the checkpoint count 78 should be 71

F2 HIGH: FR-005 requires conformance as Host, declared, while research R15 leaves out parts FBL 15.1 lists for that class (5.5, 6.2, 8.3, 8.4, 9.1); T070 would document a claim the tasks do not deliver

C1 MEDIUM: T016 runs every expression over every line of the real files including 2.6 MB of Turtle, against research R18 and SC-007, and does not say how a legitimate difference from RegExp (dot, case folding beyond ASCII) is settled

B1 MEDIUM: T067 forbids naming a binding of the corpus, but binding names include workspace, settings and job, and the contract has a parameter workspaceRoot; the match rule is not defined, and the test is written after all the code
F3 MEDIUM: research R15 lists legacyIdentities (8.7) as not implemented while T049 and T054 build and test legacy identities
F4 MEDIUM: the specification still assumes eight unmerged YAML tests will join the baseline; research found they do not belong to it
F5 MEDIUM: the 009 folder is untracked on a checkout of features/010-intellij-fbl-implementation, while T001 commits it on features/009-vscode-fbl-implementation
